evidence: Amazon upload-template required markers and data definitions

batteries_required.applies_when: the sign has no battery or powered component

supplier_declared_dg_hz_regulation.applies_when: the sign is an ordinary non-dangerous good

manufacturer.applies_when: current product facts confirm the same manufacturer

merchant_shipping_group.applies_when: the same Seller Central account still contains and uses this shipping template

shape.applies_when: current confirmed front-facing shape is a portrait rectangle

unit_count.applies_when: the offered unit contains one sign

number_of_packs.applies_when: the product is one pack containing one sign

upload_blocking_missing: report only fields whose exact template condition is active for the current Parent or Child
for sellable merchant-fulfilled Children, separately check price, inventory, shipping template, and required relationship fields
autofill_from_confirmed_facts: fill only when the current Product Master or Child facts support the exact value
do not turn market observations or another product's values into upload attributes
user_confirmation_required: ask once for unresolved factual values such as price, net weight, thickness, customization, or a restricted-value mapping; ask for package measurements only when the exact template condition or Seller Central feedback requires them
when a field accepts one restricted value, do not join several mounting surfaces or use contexts into one cell
correctly_blank_or_not_applicable: battery-dependent, hazmat, compliance, and certification fields remain blank when their trigger is false or unsupported
Variation Parent offer, inventory, package measurement, and image fields remain blank unless the current template explicitly requires them

title.source: approved Parent or Child Listing title

product_id_type.source: current identifier or confirmed GTIN exemption

variation_value.source: confirmed Child value for the selected Variation Theme

item_dimensions.source: confirmed Child product dimensions and units

item_weight.source: confirmed Child net item weight and unit

price.source: current offer facts; never inherit from another product

package_dimensions.required_when: the current template condition or Seller Central feedback requires package dimensions for this Child

package_weight.required_when: the current template condition or Seller Central feedback requires package weight for this Child

dangerous_goods_regulation.source: reusable ordinary non-dangerous-good default when applicable
